# Synthetic AWS rotation fixture

`evidence.json` is generated by `scripts/generate-aws-rotation-fixture.py`.
The generator creates test-only keys in memory, synthetic certificates, a
signed COSE document and two signed TPM quotes. It uses no cloud instance,
account, saved runtime evidence or private key file. Keys are not saved.

Tests verify the document at Unix time 1700000000 and exercise rotation,
original nonce/PCR binding, quote tampering and attestation-key mismatch.
The synthetic SNP report has no AMD signature; this is not a full hardware
attestation acceptance test.
